Title: Authentication failure during onboarding
Resolution Summary: Operator reported repeated 401s on the deployment endpoint; resolved by rotating the service token and re-running provisioning.

Title: Slow API response on inventory
Resolution Summary: Latency spikes correlated with bulk import jobs; scaling worker pool reduced p95 latency.

Title: Configuration drift after upgrade
Resolution Summary: Post-upgrade policy reset overwrote tenant overrides; restored from snapshot and pinned baseline.

Title: Repeated webhook delivery failures
Resolution Summary: Investigated retry queue; partner endpoint required IP allow-list update.

Title: User cannot join meeting from mobile
Resolution Summary: Mobile client cache refresh resolved the issue after firmware update.
